source_caption:
Scary Movie became a comedy landmark because it didn’t just parody one horror film — it attacked the entire late-’90s horror craze at once. By twisting the most recognizable moments from Scream and I Know What You Did Last Summer into absurd, shameless gags, the film turned fear into pure chaos and helped define a whole era of spoof comedy.

Scary Movie (2000), directed by Keenen Ivory Wayans, starring Anna Faris, Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans. A wildly outrageous horror spoof that turns slasher clichés, teen movie tropes, and pop culture references into nonstop absurd comedy.
